title: Step 7 - Start the Game
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Start on the first key press and track and display the level.

concepts.heading: State
points: started = false flag so only the first keypress starts the game.

concepts.heading: Key detection
points: If !started: set h1 text to 'Level 0' (via $("#level-title").text(...)), call nextSequence(), set started = true.

concepts.heading: In nextSequence
points: Increment level by 1 each call and update the h1 text to 'Level ' + level.
(Extra) The lecture's Level 0 text is immediately replaced by Level 1 in the reference, since nextSequence updates it.

code_examples.caption: Start logic

task.name: Start on keypress

steps: In nextSequence, level++ and update h1
task.expected_result: Title changes from prompt to Level 1 on first key; further keys do nothing.
